rappel_detail.station: The top of the descent snow gully on the southwest side, reached by downclimbing neve from the summit area.
rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels of about 30 m down the gully.

rappel_detail.anchor: build your own: snow, ice or rock anchor
rappel_detail.station: Partway down the southwest snow gully, at the end of the first rappel.

set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels of about 30 m down the snow gully on the southwest side are the reported descent. No fixed anchors are reported, so plan to build them.
